nodes.title: director6 (v3 walk, v2.1 scripts, H1.1 child; 16 lessons, 1,190 calls, ~$0.807) judged by 4 Claude judges by hand: beats taught 96.5/122 (79%), verdicts 205/230 (89%), right called wrong 2, wrong called right 2, contradictions 12 (+6 "?" boards); up from 39% / 75% / ≥14 / 25 in director5. Gate failed narrowly; reversal not triggered (explain beats taught ~94% outside one beat).

Close the runtime gaps: authored text and code verdicts immune to every guard (verdict → authored say/point → card, never the bare card); worked example one step per turn; model gets only a lead-in when the point is inserted; wrongIfMis before by-value, accept graded right, missed card closed after remediation; every scripted skill walked in order; asides parked and returned. Data v2.2 (then-prompt ≤120 chars, boards on every check/then-card, self-contained asks), Studio never draws a stated number as "?", H1.2 harness. Authoring of the 30-topic batch may start staged (not live) until director7 passes.
